subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should hold-to-record dictation ship enabled by default for existing web users, or should it remain opt-in until the new interaction and microphone-permission impact have explicit owner approval?
rationale: The patch adds a persistent preference but changes the default interaction of an existing composer control; source-level correctness cannot determine the intended rollout policy.

options.title: Approve default-on after lifecycle repair
options.body: Keep the default-on setting once the provider-finalization and cancellation paths are corrected and a real configured-provider run proves the user flow.

options.title: Ship opt-in first
options.body: Default the new preference off so existing users retain the prior mic-button behavior while the feature gains live-provider validation.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the interaction until an owner chooses the durable gateway/provider finalization contract and desired rollout policy.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on after lifecycle repair
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on setting once the provider-finalization and cancellation paths are corrected and a real configured-provider run proves the user flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows this person carrying the proposed interaction, implementation, and follow-up fixes; broader current-main ownership evidence was not available in the supplied review material.
